author: TechHut
description:
Go to Beautiful AI today: http://mght.co/techhut to start building better slides today!

I've run Nextcloud for years and I like it, but OpenCloud caught my eye. It's the continuation of ownCloud Infinite Scale, written in Go, with no database to babysit and no schema migrations to worry about. In this guide I go over where OpenCloud came from, how it stacks up against Nextcloud, and then a full Docker Compose setup with a real domain and certificate, storage on a local disk, full text search, and browser based document editing with Euro-Office. All links and resources are down below.

OpenCloud: https://opencloud.eu
OpenCloud Compose repo: https://github.com/opencloud-eu/opencloud-compose
Euro Office: https://github.com/euro-office/documentserver
NGINX Proxy Manager setup video: https://youtu.be/79e6KBYcVmQ
Docker getting started guide: https://techhut.tv/7-docker-basics-for-beginners/
Storage setup guide: https://github.com/TechHutTV/homelab/tree/main/storage
Frank Karlitschek inter
